source_title: Scotland’s People — Old Parish Registers, births and baptisms
query: Surname: Glasgow; Year range: to 1700; Surname options: Exact names only; all 127 results across six pages
conclusion: All 127 supplied rows are linked to 126 existing child profiles. Sixteen profiles have substantive proposed updates (including one related attribution-conflict profile); confirming rows add evidence without another update flag. The two former duplicate IDs checked in this batch redirect to existing profiles. Three repeated date/reference pairs are retained as separate index results; parent identity and birth-versus-baptism questions remain explicit.
